name: CLUE
description: CLUE is the first large-scale Chinese Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark, comprising 9 tasks including single-sentence and sentence-pair classification as well as machine reading comprehension on original Chinese text. It aims to facilitate research and applications in Chinese natural language understanding.
reputation: CLUE is a widely used and influential benchmark for Chinese language understanding, serving as a standard reference point in the Chinese NLP community.
notes: Community-driven, includes supplementary datasets and tools; benchmark website provided.
